# <span id="aanchor199"></span> Liquid Quality Source Editor

## Source Analysis Tab

Users cannot create new sources from this tab.

The Source Analysis tab displays a range of historic liquid quality data in a grid view. The “From” and “To” date selectors control the range of data displayed. The display can be altered to show current record revisions (default view) or the original record revisions:

- **Show Original** – This option shows the original data that was imported (Rev. 0 records)
- **Show Current** (default) – This shows the most current liquid quality record

Analysis information is grouped under the following sub-tabs:

- **Properties** - The aggregate properties of the analysis and their base conditions
- **Mole %** - Component mole percent values
- **Mass %** - Component mass percent values
- **LV%** - Component liquid volume percent values
- **Sample** - Sample tag and analyzer details and comments
- **Custom** - User-defined, custom fields
- **Edit Reasons** - Edit reasons and codes, and the user that made the edits

The analysis grids highlight data according to different conditions. If an analysis record is inhibited, the effective date will be in red font. Any values in the grid that appear ‘blue’ indicate that the data has been edited. Any values that appear ‘green’ indicate that the data has been calculated by FLOWCAL. Any values that are highlighted ‘yellow’ indicate an exception existing for that value. Additionally, if any unresolved exception exists, the effective date background will be highlighted yellow.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 670;height: 589;" />

Double-click a Source Analysis grid row to access the [Source Analysis Detail](Source%20Analysis%20Detail%20Screen.md) screen.

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Button Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Buttons">

The following buttons are available from the Source Analysis tab:

- **Exceptions** - Shows a brief summary of unresolved exceptions for the displayed time period
- **New Detail** - Opens the Detail screen in New mode, ready for user input. (This button is not available when the “Show Original” option is selected)
- **Open Detail** - Opens the Detail screen in read mode, providing a form view of the currently selected record
- **Exit** - Closes the editor

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Right-Click Menu">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Right-Click Menu Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Right-Click Menu">

Select or highlight one or more rows in the data grid and right-click to access options in the context menu.

- **Compare** - Opens the analysis comparison screen, which allows repeatability of two analyses per GPA 2177-03.

  On this screen, you can select a liquid quality source to compare to and use the navigation arrows on the top right to select a comparison sample. Clicking Compare at the bottom of the screen will calculate the differences for each component. You can also right-click on the grid and copy everything to the clipboard.

- **Graph** - This feature has been disabled.

- **Inhibit** - Inhibits the currently selected analyses. An inhibited analysis is not applied to any meters and is not included in any averages. It is an inactive analysis.

- **Uninhibit** - Uninhibits the currently selected analyses.

- **Add User Note** - Opens the user note dialog in Add mode with the date range pre-selected to the dates/times currently highlighted on the analysis grid.

- **View User Note** - Opens the user note dialog in View mode.

</div>

</div>
